primary.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: Allotment date, status check online by PAN number on BSE, NSE, Kfin Tech websites; listing date
primary.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields’ ₹8,981.12 crore IPO was subscribed 1.52 times. Allotment is expected on November 25, 2026, ahead of the November 27 listing. Investors can check results through KFin Technologies, NSE, BSE, or their bank, UPI, email, and demat accounts.
